+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import {
+  formatInlineCommentMarkdown,
+  WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER,
+} from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import type {
+  InlineFinding,
+  OpenRabbitConfig,
+  ReviewResult,
+} from '../types/index.js';
+
+export function verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(
+  rawBody: string,
+  signatureHeader: string | undefined,
+  secret: string | undefined
+): boolean {
+  if (!secret) return true; // No secret configured => allow in local/dev mode
+  if (!signatureHeader || !signatureHeader.startsWith('sha256=')) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  const expected =
+    'sha256=' +
+    crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody, 'utf8').digest('hex');
+
+  const sigBuf = Buffer.from(signatureHeader);
+  const expBuf = Buffer.from(expected);
+  if (sigBuf.length !== expBuf.length) return false;
+  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(sigBuf, expBuf);
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitHubPRDiff(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<string> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github.v3.diff',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/pulls/${pullNumber}`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch GitHub PR diff (${res.status}): ${await res.text()}`);
+  }
+  return await res.text();
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitHubRepoConfig(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  ref: string,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<OpenRabbitConfig> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github.v3.raw',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
+
+  for (const filename of ['.openrabbit.yaml', '.openrabbit.yml', '.coderabbit.yaml']) {
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/contents/${filename}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(
+          ref
+        )}`,
+        { headers }
+      );
+      if (res.ok) {
+        const rawYaml = await res.text();
+        return parseYamlConfig(rawYaml);
+      }
+    } catch {
+      // Ignore and try next
+    }
+  }
+  return structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG);
+}
+
+export async function upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  markdownBody: string,
+  token: string
+): Promise<{ commentId: number; updated: boolean }> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+
+  // Check if a sticky walkthrough comment already exists
+  const listRes = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${pullNumber}/comments?per_page=100`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (listRes.ok) {
+    const comments = (await listRes.json()) as any[];
+    const existing = comments.find(
+      (c) => typeof c.body === 'string' && c.body.includes(WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER)
+    );
+    if (existing) {
+      const patchRes = await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/comments/${existing.id}`,
+        {
+          method: 'PATCH',
+          headers,
+          body: JSON.stringify({ body: markdownBody }),
+        }
+      );
+      if (!patchRes.ok) {
+        throw new Error(`Failed to update walkthrough comment (${patchRes.status})`);
+      }
+      return { commentId: existing.id, updated: true };
+    }
+  }
+
+  const createRes = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${pullNumber}/comments`,
+    {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({ body: markdownBody }),
+    }
+  );
+  if (!createRes.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to post walkthrough comment (${createRes.status})`);
+  }
+  const created = (await createRes.json()) as any;
+  return { commentId: created.id, updated: false };
+}
+
+export async function postGitHubInlineReview(
+  owner: string,
+  repo: string,
+  pullNumber: number,
+  commitSha: string,
+  findings: InlineFinding[],
+  token: string
+): Promise<{ reviewId: number; commentsPosted: number }> {
+  const apiUrl = (process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com').replace(
+    /\/$/,
+    ''
+  );
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+    'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+  };
+
+  const inlineComments = findings.map((f) => ({
+    path: f.file,
+    line: f.endLine || f.startLine || 1,
+     ...(f.startLine && f.endLine && f.startLine < f.endLine
+      ? { start_line: f.startLine, start_side: 'RIGHT' }
+      : {}),
+    side: 'RIGHT',
+    body: formatInlineCommentMarkdown(f, 'github'),
+  }));
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/pulls/${pullNumber}/reviews`,
+    {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        commit_id: commitSha,
+        event: 'COMMENT',
+        body: `🐇 **OpenRabbit** completed an inline code review with **${inlineComments.length}** comment(s).`,
+        comments: inlineComments,
+      }),
+    }
+  );
+
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Failed to post GitHub inline review (${res.status}): ${await res.text()}`
+    );
+  }
+  const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+  return {
+    reviewId: data.id,
+    commentsPosted: inlineComments.length,
+  };
+}
+
+export interface GitHubWebhookResult {
+  handled: boolean;
+  action: string;
+  reviewResult?: ReviewResult;
+  chatReply?: string;
+  postedToGitHub: boolean;
+}
+
+export async function handleGitHubWebhookEvent(
+  eventName: string,
+  payload: any,
+  fallbackConfig: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<GitHubWebhookResult> {
+  const token = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
+
+  // 1. Handle Pull Request opened / synchronize / reopened
+  if (eventName === 'pull_request') {
+    const action = payload.action;
+    if (!['opened', 'synchronize', 'reopened', 'ready_for_review'].includes(action)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: `Ignored pull_request.${action}`,
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const pr = payload.pull_request || {};
+    const repoFull = payload.repository?.full_name || 'org/repo';
+    const [owner, repo] = repoFull.split('/');
+    const pullNumber = Number(pr.number || payload.number || 1);
+    const prTitle = pr.title || 'Pull Request';
+    const commitSha = pr.head?.sha || 'HEAD';
+    const baseBranch = pr.base?.ref || 'main';
+    const headBranch = pr.head?.ref || 'feat/update';
+    const author = pr.user?.login || 'developer';
+
+    if (pr.draft && !fallbackConfig.reviews.auto_review.drafts) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Skipped draft PR (reviews.auto_review.drafts is false)',
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    let rawDiff = payload.simulated_diff || '';
+    let config = fallbackConfig;
+
+    if (!rawDiff && owner && repo) {
+      rawDiff = await fetchGitHubPRDiff(owner, repo, pullNumber, token);
+      if (token) {
+        config = await fetchGitHubRepoConfig(owner, repo, commitSha, token);
+      }
+    }
+
+    const reviewResult = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository: repoFull,
+      prNumber: pullNumber,
+      author,
+      baseBranch,
+      headBranch,
+      commitSha,
+      source: 'github',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    let postedToGitHub = false;
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff && owner && repo) {
+      await upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+        owner,
+        repo,
+        pullNumber,
+        reviewResult.markdownWalkthrough,
+        token
+      );
+      if (reviewResult.findings.length > 0) {
+        await postGitHubInlineReview(
+          owner,
+          repo,
+          pullNumber,
+          commitSha,
+          reviewResult.findings,
+          token
+        );
+      }
+      postedToGitHub = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Reviewed PR #${pullNumber} (${action})`,
+      reviewResult,
+      postedToGitHub,
+    };
+  }
+
+  // 2. Handle @openrabbit interactive comments on PRs
+  if (
+    eventName === 'issue_comment' ||
+    eventName === 'pull_request_review_comment'
+  ) {
+    const commentBody: string = payload.comment?.body || '';
+    if (
+      !/(@openrabbit|@coderabbitai)\b/i.test(commentBody) ||
+      payload.action !== 'created'
+    ) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Comment did not mention @openrabbit',
+        postedToGitHub: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const chatRes = await handlePRChat(
+      {
+        query: commentBody,
+        file: payload.comment?.path,
+        line: payload.comment?.line || payload.comment?.original_line,
+        diff: payload.comment?.diff_hunk || payload.simulated_diff,
+        prTitle: payload.issue?.title || payload.pull_request?.title,
+      },
+      fallbackConfig
+    );
+
+    let postedToGitHub = false;
+    const repoFull = payload.repository?.full_name || '';
+    const [owner, repo] = repoFull.split('/');
+    const issueNumber = payload.issue?.number || payload.pull_request?.number;
+
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff && owner && repo && issueNumber) {
+      const apiUrl = (
+        process.env.GITHUB_API_URL || 'https://api.github.com'
+      ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+      await fetch(`${apiUrl}/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/${issueNumber}/comments`, {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: {
+          Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
+          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
+          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+          'User-Agent': 'OpenRabbit-Bot/1.0',
+        },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ body: chatRes.replyMarkdown }),
+      });
+      postedToGitHub = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Processed @openrabbit ${chatRes.commandDetected} command`,
+      chatReply: chatRes.replyMarkdown,
+      postedToGitHub,
+    };

+
+  return {

+    action: `Unsupported GitHub event: ${eventName}`,

+import { DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG } from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import {
+  formatInlineCommentMarkdown,
+  WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER,
+} from '../core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import type { OpenRabbitConfig, ReviewResult } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export function verifyGitLabWebhookToken(
+  headerToken: string | undefined,
+  secret: string | undefined
+): boolean {
+  if (!secret) return true;
+  return headerToken === secret;
+}
+
+export async function fetchGitLabMRDiff(
+  projectId: string | number,
+  mrIid: number,
+  token?: string
+): Promise<string> {
+  const apiUrl = (
+    process.env.GITLAB_API_URL || 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4'
+  ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
+  if (token) headers['PRIVATE-TOKEN'] = token;
+
+  const res = await fetch(
+    `${apiUrl}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
+      String(projectId)
+    )}/merge_requests/${mrIid}/changes`,
+    { headers }
+  );
+  if (!res.ok) {
+    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch GitLab MR changes (${res.status})`);
+  }
+  const data = (await res.json()) as any;
+  const changes: any[] = data.changes || [];
+
+  return changes
+    .map(
+      (c) =>
+        `diff --git a/${c.old_path} b/${c.new_path}\n--- a/${c.old_path}\n+++ b/${c.new_path}\n${c.diff}`
+    )
+    .join('\n');
+}
+
+export interface GitLabWebhookResult {
+  handled: boolean;
+  action: string;
+  reviewResult?: ReviewResult;
+  chatReply?: string;
+  postedToGitLab: boolean;
+}
+
+export async function handleGitLabWebhookEvent(
+  eventHeader: string,
+  payload: any,
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig = DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG
+): Promise<GitLabWebhookResult> {
+  const token = process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN;
+  const objectKind = payload.object_kind;
+
+  if (
+    objectKind === 'merge_request' ||
+    eventHeader === 'Merge Request Hook'
+  ) {
+    const attrs = payload.object_attributes || {};
+    const action = attrs.action || 'open';
+    if (!['open', 'reopen', 'update'].includes(action)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: `Ignored GitLab MR action: ${action}`,
+        postedToGitLab: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const projectId = payload.project?.id || '1';
+    const repoName = payload.project?.path_with_namespace || 'gitlab-org/project';
+    const mrIid = Number(attrs.iid || 1);
+    const prTitle = attrs.title || 'Merge Request';
+    const baseBranch = attrs.target_branch || 'main';
+    const headBranch = attrs.source_branch || 'feat/branch';
+    const commitSha = attrs.last_commit?.id || 'HEAD';
+    const author = payload.user?.username || 'developer';
+
+    let rawDiff = payload.simulated_diff || '';
+    if (!rawDiff) {
+      rawDiff = await fetchGitLabMRDiff(projectId, mrIid, token);
+    }
+
+    const reviewResult = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository: repoName,
+      prNumber: mrIid,
+      author,
+      baseBranch,
+      headBranch,
+      commitSha,
+      source: 'gitlab',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    let postedToGitLab = false;
+    if (token && !payload.simulated_diff) {
+      const apiUrl = (
+        process.env.GITLAB_API_URL || 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4'
+      ).replace(/\/$/, '');
+      const headers = {
+        'PRIVATE-TOKEN': token,
+        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+      };
+
+      // Post Walkthrough Note
+      await fetch(
+        `${apiUrl}/projects/${encodeURIComponent(
+          String(projectId)
+        )}/merge_requests/${mrIid}/notes`,
+        {
+          method: 'POST',
+          headers,
+          body: JSON.stringify({
+            body:
+              reviewResult.markdownWalkthrough +
+              '\n\n' +
+              reviewResult.findings
+                .map(
+                  (f) =>
+                    `#### \`${f.file}:${f.startLine}\`\n` +
+                    formatInlineCommentMarkdown(f, 'gitlab')
+                )
+                .join('\n\n---\n\n'),
+          }),
+        }
+      );
+      postedToGitLab = true;
+    }
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Reviewed GitLab MR !${mrIid} (${action})`,
+      reviewResult,
+      postedToGitLab,
+    };
+  }
+
+  if (objectKind === 'note' || eventHeader === 'Note Hook') {
+    const noteBody: string = payload.object_attributes?.note || '';
+    if (!/@openrabbit\b/i.test(noteBody)) {
+      return {
+        handled: false,
+        action: 'Note did not mention @openrabbit',
+        postedToGitLab: false,
+      };
+    }
+
+    const chatRes = await handlePRChat(
+      {
+        query: noteBody,
+        prTitle: payload.merge_request?.title,
+        diff: payload.simulated_diff,
+      },
+      config
+    );
+
+    return {
+      handled: true,
+      action: `Processed GitLab @openrabbit ${chatRes.commandDetected} command`,
+      chatReply: chatRes.replyMarkdown,
+      postedToGitLab: false,
+    };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    handled: false,
+    action: `Unsupported GitLab event: ${eventHeader || objectKind}`,
+    postedToGitLab: false,
+  };
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import http from 'node:http';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import {
+  loadConfig,
+  mergeConfig,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+  serializeConfigToYaml,
+} from '../config/config-loader.js';
+import { handlePRChat } from '../core/chat-engine.js';
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from '../core/diff-parser.js';
+import { getLocalGitDiff } from '../core/git-utils.js';
+import {
+  getProvidersStatus,
+  resolveActiveProvider,
+} from '../core/llm-provider.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../core/review-engine.js';
+import {
+  handleGitHubWebhookEvent,
+  verifyGitHubWebhookSignature,
+} from '../integrations/github.js';
+import {
+  handleGitLabWebhookEvent,
+  verifyGitLabWebhookToken,
+} from '../integrations/gitlab.js';
+import {
+  ReviewStore,
+  SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES,
+} from '../storage/review-store.js';
+
+const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
+const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
+
+export interface ServerInstance {
+  server: http.Server;
+  store: ReviewStore;
+  port: number;
+  close: () => Promise<void>;
+}
+
+function readBody(req: http.IncomingMessage): Promise<string> {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
+    req.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk)));
+    req.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')));
+    req.on('error', reject);
+  });
+}
+
+function sendJson(
+  res: http.ServerResponse,
+  status: number,
+  payload: unknown
+): void {
+  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
+  res.writeHead(status, {
+    'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS',
+    'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':
+      'Content-Type, X-GitHub-Event, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Gitlab-Event, X-Gitlab-Token',
+  });
+  res.end(body);
+}
+
+const MIME_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
+  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
+  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
+  '.js': 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8',
+  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
+  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
+  '.ico': 'image/x-icon',
+};
+
+export async function createOpenRabbitServer(options: {
+  port?: number;
+  workspaceDir?: string;
+  storageDir?: string;
+} = {}): Promise<ServerInstance> {
+  const workspaceDir = options.workspaceDir || process.cwd();
+  const store = new ReviewStore(
+    options.storageDir || path.join(workspaceDir, 'data')
+  );
+  await store.init();
+
+  const publicDirCandidates = [
+    path.join(workspaceDir, 'public'),
+    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../public'),
+  ];
+  const publicDir =
+    publicDirCandidates.find((d) => fs.existsSync(d)) || publicDirCandidates[0];
+
+  const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
+    try {
+      if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
+        res.writeHead(204, {
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS',
+          'Access-Control-Allow-Headers':
+            'Content-Type, X-GitHub-Event, X-Hub-Signature-256, X-Gitlab-Event, X-Gitlab-Token',
+        });
+        res.end();
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const url = new URL(req.url || '/', `http://${req.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
+      const pathname = url.pathname;
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // API Routes
+      // ======================================================================
+      if (pathname === '/api/status' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const { config, configPath } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const activeProvider = resolveActiveProvider(
+          config.llm.provider,
+          config.llm.model
+        );
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          version: '1.0.0',
+          activeProvider,
+          providers: getProvidersStatus(),
+          config,
+          configPath,
+          yamlConfig: serializeConfigToYaml(config),
+          analytics,
+          webhooks: {
+            githubConfigured: Boolean(process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN),
+            gitlabConfigured: Boolean(process.env.GITLAB_TOKEN),
+          },
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/templates' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        sendJson(res, 200, { templates: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/reviews' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const reviews = await store.listReviews();
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+        sendJson(res, 200, { reviews, analytics });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname.startsWith('/api/reviews/') && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const id = pathname.slice('/api/reviews/'.length);
+        const review = await store.getReviewById(id);
+        if (!review) {
+          sendJson(res, 404, { error: 'Review not found' });
+          return;
+        }
+        const parsedDiff = review.rawDiff
+          ? parseUnifiedDiff(review.rawDiff)
+          : { files: [], totalAdditions: 0, totalDeletions: 0, totalFiles: 0 };
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/review' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const diff = String(body.diff || '');
+        if (!diff.trim()) {
+          sendJson(res, 400, { error: 'Diff content is required.' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const { config: baseConfig } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        let effectiveConfig = structuredClone(baseConfig);
+        if (body.yamlConfig && typeof body.yamlConfig === 'string') {
+          effectiveConfig = parseYamlConfig(body.yamlConfig);
+        }
+        if (body.profile) {
+          effectiveConfig.profile = body.profile;
+        }
+        if (body.provider) {
+          effectiveConfig.llm.provider = body.provider;
+        }
+        if (body.model) {
+          effectiveConfig.llm.model = body.model;
+        }
+
+        const review = await runPullRequestReview({
+          rawDiff: diff,
+          prTitle: body.prTitle || 'Interactive PR Review',
+          repository: body.repository || 'local/playground',
+          prNumber: body.prNumber ? Number(body.prNumber) : undefined,
+          author: body.author || 'developer',
+          source: body.source || 'playground',
+          config: effectiveConfig,
+        });
+
+        await store.addReview(review);
+        const parsedDiff = parseUnifiedDiff(diff);
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff, analytics });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/review/local' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const localInfo = getLocalGitDiff({
+          cwd: workspaceDir,
+          staged: Boolean(body.staged),
+          baseBranch: body.baseBranch,
+        });
+
+        if (!localInfo.diff.trim()) {
+          sendJson(res, 200, {
+            empty: true,
+            message:
+              'No uncommitted git changes or commits found in the local repository. Try loading one of the sample PR diffs or modifying a file!',
+          });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const review = await runPullRequestReview({
+          rawDiff: localInfo.diff,
+          prTitle: `Local Review: ${localInfo.description} (${localInfo.branch})`,
+          repository: localInfo.repoName,
+          author: localInfo.author,
+          headBranch: localInfo.branch,
+          source: 'cli',
+          config,
+        });
+
+        await store.addReview(review);
+        const parsedDiff = parseUnifiedDiff(localInfo.diff);
+        const analytics = await store.getAnalyticsSummary();
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, { review, parsedDiff, analytics, localInfo });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/chat' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        if (body.provider) {
+          config.llm.provider = body.provider;
+        }
+
+        const chatResponse = await handlePRChat(
+          {
+            query: String(body.query || '@openrabbit explain'),
+            diff: body.diff,
+            file: body.file,
+            line: body.line,
+            findingContext: body.findingContext,
+            prTitle: body.prTitle,
+          },
+          config
+        );
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, chatResponse);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/config' && req.method === 'GET') {
+        const { config, configPath } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          config,
+          configPath,
+          yaml: serializeConfigToYaml(config),
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/config' && req.method === 'PUT') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const body = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config: currentConfig } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+
+        const updatedConfig = body.yaml
+          ? parseYamlConfig(String(body.yaml))
+          : mergeConfig(currentConfig, body.config || {});
+
+        const targetPath = path.join(workspaceDir, '.openrabbit.yaml');
+        const yamlString = serializeConfigToYaml(updatedConfig);
+        fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, yamlString, 'utf8');
+
+        sendJson(res, 200, {
+          saved: true,
+          configPath: targetPath,
+          config: updatedConfig,
+          yaml: yamlString,
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // GitHub & GitLab Webhook Endpoints
+      // ======================================================================
+      if (pathname === '/api/webhooks/github' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const sigHeader = req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'] as
+          | string
+          | undefined;
+        const eventName =
+          (req.headers['x-github-event'] as string) || 'pull_request';
+
+        if (
+          !verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(
+            rawBody,
+            sigHeader,
+            process.env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
+          )
+        ) {
+          sendJson(res, 401, { error: 'Invalid GitHub webhook signature' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const result = await handleGitHubWebhookEvent(eventName, payload, config);
+        if (result.reviewResult) {
+          await store.addReview(result.reviewResult);
+        }
+        sendJson(res, 200, result);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (pathname === '/api/webhooks/gitlab' && req.method === 'POST') {
+        const rawBody = await readBody(req);
+        const tokenHeader = req.headers['x-gitlab-token'] as string | undefined;
+        const eventHeader =
+          (req.headers['x-gitlab-event'] as string) || 'Merge Request Hook';
+
+        if (
+          !verifyGitLabWebhookToken(
+            tokenHeader,
+            process.env.GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
+          )
+        ) {
+          sendJson(res, 401, { error: 'Invalid GitLab webhook token' });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody || '{}');
+        const { config } = loadConfig(workspaceDir);
+        const result = await handleGitLabWebhookEvent(
+          eventHeader,
+          payload,
+          config
+        );
+        if (result.reviewResult) {
+          await store.addReview(result.reviewResult);
+        }
+        sendJson(res, 200, result);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      // ======================================================================
+      // Static Files (Web Dashboard & Interactive Playground)
+      // ======================================================================
+      const safePath = pathname === '/' ? '/index.html' : pathname;
+      const resolvedFile = path.join(publicDir, path.normalize(safePath));
+      if (
+        resolvedFile.startsWith(publicDir) &&
+        fs.existsSync(resolvedFile) &&
+        fs.statSync(resolvedFile).isFile()
+      ) {
+        const ext = path.extname(resolvedFile).toLowerCase();
+        const contentType = MIME_TYPES[ext] || 'application/octet-stream';
+        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': contentType });
+        fs.createReadStream(resolvedFile).pipe(res);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      sendJson(res, 404, { error: `Not found: ${pathname}` });
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('[OpenRabbit Server Error]', err);
+      sendJson(res, 500, {
+        error: (err as Error).message || 'Internal Server Error',
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  const requestedPort =
+    options.port !== undefined
+      ? options.port
+      : Number(process.env.PORT || 3847);
+
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    server.on('error', reject);
+    server.listen(requestedPort, () => {
+      const addr = server.address();
+      const actualPort =
+        typeof addr === 'object' && addr ? addr.port : requestedPort;
+      resolve({
+        server,
+        store,
+        port: actualPort,
+        close: () =>
+          new Promise<void>((resClose, rejClose) =>
+            server.close((e) => (e ? rejClose(e) : resClose()))
+          ),
+      });
+    });
+  });
+}

+    repository: 'acme-corp/telemetry-engine',
+    prNumber: 315,
+    author: 'ElenaR',
+    description:
+      'A clean, well-typed TypeScript implementation demonstrating OpenRabbit walkthrough diagrams and architectural praise.',
+    diff: `diff --git a/src/worker/batch-dispatcher.ts b/src/worker/batch-dispatcher.ts
+index 89a1b2c..c4d5e6f 100644
+--- a/src/worker/batch-dispatcher.ts
++++ b/src/worker/batch-dispatcher.ts
+@@ -4,9 +4,22 @@ export interface TelemetryEvent {
+   timestamp: number;
+ }
+ 
+-export async function flushEvents(events: TelemetryEvent[]): Promise<number> {
+-  return events.length;
++export async function flushEventsBatch(
++  events: readonly TelemetryEvent[],
++  batchSize: number = 50
++): Promise<{ flushed: number; batches: number }> {
++  if (events.length === 0) {
++    return { flushed: 0, batches: 0 };
++  }
++
++  let batches = 0;
++  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i += batchSize) {
++    const chunk = events.slice(i, i + batchSize);
++    await Promise.all(chunk.map((ev) => Promise.resolve(ev.timestamp)));
++    batches += 1;
++  }
++
++  return { flushed: events.length, batches };
+ }
+`,
+  },
+];
+
+export class ReviewStore {
+  private filePath: string;
+  private reviews: ReviewResult[] = [];
+  private initialized = false;
+
+  constructor(storageDir: string = path.join(process.cwd(), 'data')) {
+    if (!fs.existsSync(storageDir)) {
+      fs.mkdirSync(storageDir, { recursive: true });
+    }
+    this.filePath = path.join(storageDir, 'reviews.json');
+  }
+
+  public async init(): Promise<void> {
+    if (this.initialized) return;
+    this.initialized = true;
+
+    if (fs.existsSync(this.filePath)) {
+      try {
+        const raw = fs.readFileSync(this.filePath, 'utf8');
+        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
+        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
+          this.reviews = parsed;
+          return;
+        }
+      } catch {
+        // Re-seed if corrupted
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Seed with initial sample reviews so the dashboard is immediately rich
+    const seeded: ReviewResult[] = [];
+    const heuristicConfig = structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG);
+    heuristicConfig.llm.provider = 'heuristic';
+    heuristicConfig.profile = 'assertive';
+
+    for (let i = 0; i < SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES.length; i++) {
+      const tpl = SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[i];
+      const rev = await runPullRequestReview({
+        rawDiff: tpl.diff,
+        prTitle: tpl.prTitle,
+        repository: tpl.repository,
+        prNumber: tpl.prNumber,
+        author: tpl.author,
+        source: i === 0 ? 'github' : i === 1 ? 'gitlab' : 'cli',
+        config: heuristicConfig,
+      });
+      seeded.push(rev);
+    }
+
+    this.reviews = seeded;
+    this.persist();
+  }
+
+  public async listReviews(): Promise<ReviewResult[]> {
+    await this.init();
+    return this.reviews;
+  }
+
+  public async getReviewById(id: string): Promise<ReviewResult | undefined> {
+    await this.init();
+    return this.reviews.find((r) => r.id === id);
+  }
+
+  public async addReview(review: ReviewResult): Promise<ReviewResult> {
+    await this.init();
+    this.reviews.unshift(review);
+    if (this.reviews.length > 100) {
+      this.reviews = this.reviews.slice(0, 100);
+    }
+    this.persist();
+    return review;
+  }
+
+  public async getAnalyticsSummary() {
+    await this.init();
+    const totalReviews = this.reviews.length;
+    const totalFiles = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.filesReviewed,
+      0
+    );
+    const totalFindings = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.findingsCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const criticalCaught = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.criticalCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const warningsCaught = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.warningCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const suggestionsMade = this.reviews.reduce(
+      (s, r) => s + r.stats.suggestionCount,
+      0
+    );
+    const avgDurationMs =
+      totalReviews > 0
+        ? Math.round(
+            this.reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.durationMs, 0) / totalReviews
+          )
+        : 0;
+
+    const categoryBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
+    for (const r of this.reviews) {
+      for (const f of r.findings) {
+        categoryBreakdown[f.category] = (categoryBreakdown[f.category] || 0) + 1;
+      }
+    }
+
+    return {
+      totalReviews,
+      totalFiles,
+      totalFindings,
+      criticalCaught,
+      warningsCaught,
+      suggestionsMade,
+      avgDurationMs,
+      estimatedHoursSaved: +(totalReviews * 0.45 + totalFindings * 0.15).toFixed(1),
+      categoryBreakdown,
+    };
+  }
+
+  private persist(): void {
+    try {
+      fs.writeFileSync(
+        this.filePath,
+        JSON.stringify(this.reviews, null, 2),
+        'utf8'
+      );
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn('[OpenRabbit] Failed to persist reviews:', err);
+    }
+  }
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import os from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
+import {
+  DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG,
+  getMatchingPathInstructions,
+  parseYamlConfig,
+  shouldReviewFile,
+} from '../src/config/config-loader.js';
+import { detectChatCommand, handlePRChat } from '../src/core/chat-engine.js';
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from '../src/core/diff-parser.js';
+import { WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER } from '../src/core/markdown-formatter.js';
+import { runPullRequestReview } from '../src/core/review-engine.js';
+import { verifyGitHubWebhookSignature } from '../src/integrations/github.js';
+import { createOpenRabbitServer } from '../src/server/app.js';
+import { SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES } from '../src/storage/review-store.js';
+
+describe('OpenRabbit Core Suite', () => {
+  it('parses unified git diffs, line numbers, and changed symbols accurately', () => {
+    const sample = SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff;
+    const parsed = parseUnifiedDiff(sample);
+
+    assert.equal(parsed.totalFiles, 1);
+    const file = parsed.files[0];
+    assert.equal(file.newPath, 'src/api/auth-controller.ts');
+    assert.equal(file.language, 'TypeScript');
+    assert.ok(file.additions > 0);
+    assert.ok(file.symbolsChanged.includes('lookupUserByEmail'));
+    assert.ok(file.symbolsChanged.includes('revokeUserSessions'));
+  });
+
+  it('filters paths and matches .openrabbit.yaml path_instructions via globs', () => {
+    const filters = ['!dist/**', '!*.lock', 'src/**'];
+    assert.equal(shouldReviewFile('src/api/user.ts', filters), true);
+    assert.equal(shouldReviewFile('dist/bundle.js', filters), false);
+    assert.equal(shouldReviewFile('yarn.lock', filters), false);
+
+    const instructions = [
+      { path: 'src/api/**', instructions: 'Check SQLi' },
+      { path: '**/*.tsx', instructions: 'Check hooks' },
+    ];
+    const matched = getMatchingPathInstructions('src/api/auth.ts', instructions);
+    assert.equal(matched.length, 1);
+    assert.equal(matched[0].instructions, 'Check SQLi');
+  });
+
+  it('generates PR walkthrough, Mermaid diagram, poem, and committable suggestions', async () => {
+    const config = structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG);
+    config.profile = 'assertive';
+    config.llm.provider = 'heuristic';
+
+    const result = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff,
+      prTitle: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].prTitle,
+      repository: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].repository,
+      prNumber: 142,
+      config,
+    });
+
+    assert.ok(result.markdownWalkthrough.includes(WALKTHROUGH_COMMENT_MARKER));
+    assert.ok(result.walkthrough.mermaidDiagram.includes('sequenceDiagram'));
+    assert.ok(result.walkthrough.poem.length > 10);
+    assert.equal(result.walkthrough.riskLevel, 'critical');
+    assert.ok(result.stats.criticalCount >= 2);
+
+    // Ensure SQL injection and hardcoded secret findings include committable suggestions
+    const sqliFinding = result.findings.find(
+      (f) => f.ruleMatched === 'sec-sql-injection'
+    );
+    assert.ok(sqliFinding, 'Expected SQL injection finding');
+    assert.ok(
+      sqliFinding.suggestionCode && sqliFinding.suggestionCode.includes('$1'),
+      'Expected parameterized SQL suggestion block'
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('suppresses nitpicks when profile is set to chill', async () => {
+    const chillConfig = parseYamlConfig('profile: chill\nllm:\n  provider: heuristic');
+    const assertiveConfig = parseYamlConfig(
+      'profile: assertive\nllm:\n  provider: heuristic'
+    );
+
+    const chillReview = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff,
+      config: chillConfig,
+    });
+    const assertiveReview = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff,
+      config: assertiveConfig,
+    });
+
+    assert.equal(chillReview.stats.nitpickCount, 0);
+    assert.ok(assertiveReview.stats.nitpickCount >= 1);
+  });
+
+  it('handles @openrabbit interactive PR chat commands (test, explain, fix, resolve)', async () => {
+    assert.equal(
+      detectChatCommand('@openrabbit generate unit tests for this'),
+      'test'
+    );
+    assert.equal(detectChatCommand('@openrabbit explain how this works'), 'explain');
+    assert.equal(detectChatCommand('@openrabbit fix this bug'), 'fix');
+
+    const testReply = await handlePRChat({
+      query: '@openrabbit generate unit tests',
+      diff: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff,
+      file: 'src/api/auth-controller.ts',
+    });
+    assert.equal(testReply.commandDetected, 'test');
+    assert.ok(testReply.replyMarkdown.includes('describe('));
+    assert.ok(testReply.replyMarkdown.includes('lookupUserByEmail'));
+  });
+
+  it('verifies GitHub HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures', () => {
+    const body = '{"action":"opened"}';
+    const secret = 'my_webhook_secret';
+    // Invalid signature should return false
+    assert.equal(
+      verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(body, 'sha256=deadbeef', secret),
+      false
+    );
+    // Empty secret allows local testing
+    assert.equal(verifyGitHubWebhookSignature(body, undefined, undefined), true);
+  });
+
+  it('serves REST API and processes simulated GitHub & GitLab webhooks', async () => {
+    const tmpDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'openrabbit-test-'));
+    const serverInstance = await createOpenRabbitServer({
+      port: 0,
+      workspaceDir: process.cwd(),
+      storageDir: tmpDir,
+    });
+
+    try {
+      const baseUrl = `http://localhost:${serverInstance.port}`;
+
+      const statusRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/status`).then((r) => r.json());
+      assert.equal(statusRes.version, '1.0.0');
+      assert.ok(Array.isArray(statusRes.providers));
+
+      const ghWebhookRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/webhooks/github`, {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: {
+          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+          'X-GitHub-Event': 'pull_request',
+        },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          action: 'opened',
+          number: 77,
+          repository: { full_name: 'test/repo' },
+          pull_request: {
+            number: 77,
+            title: 'feat: test webhook PR',
+          },
+          simulated_diff: SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff,
+        }),
+      }).then((r) => r.json());
+
+      assert.equal(ghWebhookRes.handled, true);
+      assert.ok(ghWebhookRes.reviewResult.findings.length > 0);
+    } finally {
+      await serverInstance.close();
+    }
+  });
+});

findings.title: Python mutable default argument retains state across function calls
findings.body: Default argument values in Python are evaluated once when the function is defined. Using mutable defaults (`[]`, `{}`) causes state to be shared across all invocations (**Common Python Bug**). Use `None` as the default and assign a new instance inside the function body.

findings.originalCode: def get_customers(tenant_id: str, filters: dict = {}) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

findings.title: Python SQL Injection via f-string or string formatting
findings.body: Interpolating variables into SQL queries via Python f-strings or `%` format strings causes **SQL Injection (CWE-89)**. Use database cursor parameterized queries with placeholders (`%s` or `?`) and a parameter tuple/list.
findings.suggestionCode: query = "SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = %s", (tenant_id,)
findings.originalCode: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = '{tenant_id}'"

findings.title: Python `shell=True` or `os.system()` allows command injection
findings.body: Invoking shell commands with `shell=True` or `os.system()` invites **Command Injection (CWE-78)** if arguments contain untrusted user input. Pass arguments as a list of strings (`["cmd", arg1, arg2]`) with `shell=False`.

findings.title: Bare `except:` catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt
findings.body: A bare `except:` catches `KeyboardInterrupt` (Ctrl+C) and `SystemExit`, preventing normal application termination and masking unexpected syntax or type errors. Catch `Exception` explicitly.

+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+from typing import List, Dict, Any
+
+def get_customers(tenant_id: str, filters: dict = {}) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    conn = sqlite3.connect("app.db")
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+    # Raw f-string SQL query
+    query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = '{tenant_id}'"
+    cursor.execute(query)
+    rows = cursor.fetchall()
+    return [{"id": r[0], "name": r[1], "email": r[2]} for r in rows]
+
+def export_backup_report(output_path: str, table_name: str) -> None:
+    try:
+        cmd = f"sqlite3 app.db .dump {table_name} > {output_path}"
+        subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, check=True)
+    except:
+        pass

+name: OpenRabbit AI PR Review
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: write
+  issues: write
+
+jobs:
+  openrabbit:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.comment.body, '@openrabbit') }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout Repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Setup Node.js 22
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: 'npm'
+
+      - name: Install Dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Run OpenRabbit PR Walkthrough & Inline Review
+        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
+        run: |
+          npx tsx src/cli/index.ts review \
+            --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }} \
+            --title "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" \
+            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
+            --pr "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" \
+            --post-github "${{ github.repository }}#${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
+          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
+          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}

+# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://openrabbit.dev/schema/v1.json
+# ============================================================================
+# OpenRabbit Configuration (.openrabbit.yaml)
+# Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion
+# ============================================================================
+
+language: en-US
+profile: chill
+tone_instructions: Be constructive, concise, and high-signal. Prioritize real bugs, security vulnerabilities, race conditions, and performance bottlenecks over stylistic nitpicks.
+early_access: true
+reviews:
+  high_level_summary: true
+  poem: true
+  review_status: true
+  collapse_walkthrough: false
+  sequence_diagrams: true
+  auto_review:
+    enabled: true
+    drafts: false
+    base_branches:
+      - main
+      - master
+      - develop
+  path_filters:
+    - "!dist/**"
+    - "!node_modules/**"
+    - "!*.lock"
+    - "!package-lock.json"
+    - "!pnpm-lock.yaml"
+    - "!**/*.min.js"
+    - "!**/*.snap"
+  path_instructions:
+    - path: src/api/**
+      instructions: Verify authentication checks, input validation, rate limiting, and SQL/command injection safety on all endpoints.
+    - path: "**/*.tsx"
+      instructions: Check for React hook dependency array bugs, stale closures, memory leaks in useEffect, and accessibility attributes.
+    - path: tests/**
+      instructions: Ensure tests cover edge cases, error paths, and avoid brittle timing assumptions.
+chat:
+  auto_reply: true
+llm:
+  provider: auto
+  temperature: 0.2

+# 🐇 OpenRabbit
+
+**Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer, Walkthrough Generator & Interactive PR Companion**  
+*An open-source, self-hostable, multi-provider BYOK alternative to CodeRabbit.*
+
+---
+
+## ✨ Why OpenRabbit?
+
+Code reviews shouldn't require surrendering your proprietary source code to a closed SaaS or paying per-seat enterprise fees. **OpenRabbit** brings the signature capabilities developers love about CodeRabbit into a fast, transparent, open-source platform:
+
+1. **🧭 Two-Stage PR Walkthroughs**:
+   - Executive Summary & Release Notes grouped by module
+   - File-by-File Walkthrough Table with component detection & impact badges (`🟢 Low`, `🟡 Med`, `🔴 High`)
+   - Auto-generated **Mermaid Sequence Diagrams** (`sequenceDiagram`) visualizing how PR changes interact at runtime
+   - **Review Effort Score** (`1/5` to `5/5`) & Risk Assessment
+   - Configurable **Rabbit Poem** summarizing every PR 🐇🥕
+   - Updates a single sticky comment (`<!-- openrabbit-walkthrough -->`) on new commits instead of spamming your PR!
+2. **📝 Line-by-Line Inline Code Reviews with One-Click Committable Suggestions**:
+   - Pinpoints exact diff lines and emits GitHub (` ```suggestion `) and GitLab (` ```suggestion:-0+0 `) committable code blocks.
+   - Combines a built-in deterministic **Static + AST Security/Concurrency Analyzer** with **Multi-Provider LLMs**.
+3. **💬 Interactive `@openrabbit` PR Chat & Commands**:
+   - Reply in any PR or inline review thread with:
+     - `@openrabbit explain` — Deep-dive explanation of the hunk & execution flow
+     - `@openrabbit test` — Generates ready-to-run unit test suites (`Vitest`/`Jest`) for the modified functions
+     - `@openrabbit fix` — Produces a committable replacement patch
+     - `@openrabbit docstring` — Generates JSDoc/TSDoc for changed symbols
+     - `@openrabbit resolve` — Marks the review discussion resolved
+4. **🔑 Multi-Provider BYOK + 100% Private Local Mode**:
+   - **OpenAI** (`gpt-4o`, `o3-mini`, or any compatible endpoint like Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter)
+   - **Anthropic Claude** (`claude-3-7-sonnet-latest`)
+   - **Google Gemini** (`gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash`)
+   - **Ollama** (`qwen2.5-coder`, `deepseek-r1`, `llama3.3` for 100% air-gapped private reviews)
+   - **Built-in Static/AST Heuristic Engine** (works immediately with zero API keys!)
+5. **⚙️ Drop-in `.openrabbit.yaml` & `.coderabbit.yaml` Compatibility**:
+   - Supports `profile: chill | assertive | security-focused`, glob `path_filters`, and per-directory `path_instructions`.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ Architecture
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+  subgraph Triggers["Triggers & Sources"]
+    GH["GitHub Webhook / Action"]
+    GL["GitLab MR Webhook"]
+    CLI["OpenRabbit CLI (git diff)"]
+    UI["Interactive Web Studio"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Core["OpenRabbit Core Engine"]
+    DP["Unified Diff & Symbol Parser"]
+    CFG[".openrabbit.yaml Matcher"]
+    AST["Static & Security AST Rules"]
+    LLM["Multi-Provider LLM Router"]
+    CHAT["@openrabbit Chat Engine"]
+  end
+
+  subgraph Outputs["Outputs"]
+    WK["Sticky PR Walkthrough + Mermaid Diagram"]
+    INL["Inline Review + Committable Suggestions"]
+    DASH["Analytics & Rule Studio Dashboard"]
+  end
+
+  Triggers --> DP
+  DP --> CFG
+  CFG --> AST
+  CFG --> LLM
+  AST --> WK
+  LLM --> WK
+  AST --> INL
+  LLM --> INL
+  CHAT --> INL
+  WK --> Outputs
+  INL --> Outputs
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🚀 Quickstart
+
+### 1. Run a Terminal PR Review (`openrabbit review`)
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies
+npm install
+
+# Run a live terminal review on a sample PR (or your local uncommitted git diff)
+npm run review -- --demo auth-jwt-sqli
+
+# Review your staged git changes
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts review --staged
+
+# Ask @openrabbit to generate unit tests from the CLI
+npx tsx src/cli/index.ts chat "@openrabbit generate unit tests"
+```
+
+### 2. Launch the Interactive Web Dashboard & Webhook Server (`openrabbit serve`)
+
+```bash
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Then open **`http://localhost:3847`** to explore:
+- **🔎 PR Review Studio**: Paste any `git diff`, switch between curated PR scenarios, inspect the rendered **Mermaid Sequence Diagram**, click **✨ Apply Fix to Diff & Re-Verify** on committable suggestions, and chat with `@openrabbit` inline!
+- **📊 Reviews & Analytics**: Track PRs reviewed, critical vulnerabilities caught, and engineering hours saved.
+- **⚙️ `.openrabbit.yaml` Studio**: Visually configure `chill` vs `assertive` profiles, `path_instructions`, and BYOK LLM providers.
+- **🔌 Webhook Simulator**: Test GitHub (`pull_request`, `issue_comment`) and GitLab (`Merge Request Hook`) webhooks with one click.
+
+---
+
+## ⚙️ Configuration (`.openrabbit.yaml`)
+
+```yaml
+language: en-US
+profile: chill # chill | assertive | security-focused
+tone_instructions: Be constructive, concise, and high-signal.
+reviews:
+  high_level_summary: true
+  poem: true
+  sequence_diagrams: true
+  collapse_walkthrough: false
+  path_filters:
+    - "!dist/**"
+    - "!*.lock"
+  path_instructions:
+    - path: "src/api/**"
+      instructions: "Verify authentication checks, input validation, and parameterized SQL queries."
+    - path: "**/*.tsx"
+      instructions: "Check for React hook dependency bugs and memory leaks."
+chat:
+  auto_reply: true
+llm:
+  provider: auto # auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic
+  temperature: 0.2
+```
+
+---
+
+## 🧪 Running Tests & Building
+
+```bash
+# Run the automated unit & webhook integration test suite
+npm test
+
+# Compile TypeScript to dist/
+npm run build
+```
+
+## 📄 License
+
+MIT

+++ b/public/app.js
@@ -0,0 +1,783 @@
+/* global mermaid */
+(function () {
+  let templates = [];
+  let currentReview = null;
+  let currentParsedDiff = null;
+
+  if (typeof mermaid !== 'undefined') {
+    mermaid.initialize({
+      startOnLoad: false,
+      theme: 'dark',
+      securityLevel: 'loose',
+    });
+  }
+
+  function escapeHtml(str) {
+    return String(str ?? '')
+      .replace(/&/g, '&')
+      .replace(/</g, '<')
+      .replace(/>/g, '>')
+      .replace(/"/g, '"');
+  }
+
+  function formatInlineMarkdown(text) {
+    return escapeHtml(text)
+      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
+      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
+  }
+
+  // Tab Navigation
+  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach((btn) => {
+    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const target = btn.getAttribute('data-tab');
+      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('active'));
+      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'));
+      btn.classList.add('active');
+      const panel = document.getElementById(`tab-${target}`);
+      if (panel) panel.classList.add('active');
+      if (target === 'history') {
+        loadHistoryAndAnalytics();
+      }
+    });
+  });
+
+  async function initApp() {
+    try {
+      const [statusRes, tplRes, revRes] = await Promise.all([
+        fetch('/api/status').then((r) => r.json()),
+        fetch('/api/templates').then((r) => r.json()),
+        fetch('/api/reviews').then((r) => r.json()),
+      ]);
+
+      // Engine badge
+      const engineEl = document.getElementById('activeEngineText');
+      if (statusRes.activeProvider) {
+        engineEl.textContent = `Engine: ${statusRes.activeProvider.provider}/${statusRes.activeProvider.model}`;
+      }
+
+      // Populate Rules & Providers tab
+      renderProvidersStatus(statusRes.providers || []);
+      populateConfigForm(statusRes.config, statusRes.yamlConfig);
+
+      // Populate Sample Templates
+      templates = tplRes.templates || [];
+      renderTemplatePills();
+
+      // Load first template into editor & show initial seeded review
+      if (templates.length > 0) {
+        selectTemplate(templates[0], false);
+      }
+
+      if (revRes.reviews && revRes.reviews.length > 0) {
+        await loadReviewById(revRes.reviews[0].id);
+      } else if (templates.length > 0) {
+        await executeReview();
+      }
+
+      renderAnalyticsAndHistory(revRes.reviews || [], revRes.analytics || {});
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('Failed to initialize OpenRabbit UI:', err);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function renderTemplatePills() {
+    const container = document.getElementById('templatePills');
+    container.innerHTML = '';
+    templates.forEach((tpl, index) => {
+      const btn = document.createElement('button');
+      btn.className = `template-pill ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}`;
+      btn.setAttribute('data-tpl-id', tpl.id);
+      btn.innerHTML = `
+        <div class="template-pill-title">
+          <span>${escapeHtml(tpl.name)}</span>
+          <span class="mono-hint">#${tpl.prNumber}</span>
+        </div>
+        <div class="template-pill-desc">${escapeHtml(tpl.description)}</div>
+      `;
+      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.template-pill').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'));
+        btn.classList.add('active');
+        selectTemplate(tpl, true);
+      });
+      container.appendChild(btn);
+    });
+  }
+
+  function selectTemplate(tpl, autoRun) {
+    document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = tpl.prTitle;
+    document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = tpl.repository;
+    const diffArea = document.getElementById('textareaDiff');
+    diffArea.value = tpl.diff;
+    updateDiffLineCounter();
+    if (autoRun) {
+      executeReview();
+    }
+  }
+
+  function updateDiffLineCounter() {
+    const val = document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value || '';
+    const count = val.trim() ? val.split('\n').length : 0;
+    document.getElementById('diffLineStats').textContent = `${count} lines`;
+  }
+
+  document
+    .getElementById('textareaDiff')
+    .addEventListener('input', updateDiffLineCounter);
+
+  async function executeReview() {
+    const btn = document.getElementById('btnRunReview');
+    const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+    btn.disabled = true;
+    btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Analyzing Diff & Generating Walkthrough...';
+
+    try {
+      const diff = document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value;
+      const prTitle = document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value;
+      const repository = document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value;
+      const profile = document.getElementById('selectProfile').value;
+      const provider = document.getElementById('selectProvider').value;
+
+      const res = await fetch('/api/review', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          diff,
+          prTitle,
+          repository,
+          profile,
+          provider,
+          source: 'playground',
+        }),
+      });
+      const data = await res.json();
+      if (data.error) {
+        alert(data.error);
+        return;
+      }
+      currentReview = data.review;
+      currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+      renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('Review error:', err);
+    } finally {
+      btn.disabled = false;
+      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+    }
+  }
+
+  document.getElementById('btnRunReview').addEventListener('click', executeReview);
+
+  document.getElementById('btnReviewLocalGit').addEventListener('click', async () => {
+    const btn = document.getElementById('btnReviewLocalGit');
+    btn.textContent = '⏳ Reading git diff...';
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch('/api/review/local', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({}),
+      });
+      const data = await res.json();
+      if (data.empty) {
+        alert(data.message);
+        return;
+      }
+      if (data.review) {
+        document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = data.review.prTitle;
+        document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = data.review.repository;
+        document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value = data.review.rawDiff || '';
+        updateDiffLineCounter();
+        currentReview = data.review;
+        currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+        renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+      }
+    } finally {
+      btn.textContent = '📂 Review Local Git Diff';
+    }
+  });
+
+  async function loadReviewById(id) {
+    const res = await fetch(`/api/reviews/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
+    if (!res.ok) return;
+    const data = await res.json();
+    currentReview = data.review;
+    currentParsedDiff = data.parsedDiff;
+    if (currentReview.rawDiff) {
+      document.getElementById('textareaDiff').value = currentReview.rawDiff;
+      document.getElementById('inputPrTitle').value = currentReview.prTitle;
+      document.getElementById('inputRepoName').value = currentReview.repository;
+      updateDiffLineCounter();
+    }
+    renderReviewStudio(currentReview, currentParsedDiff);
+  }
+
+  async function renderReviewStudio(review, parsedDiff) {
+    const w = review.walkthrough;
+    document.getElementById('viewPrTitle').textContent = review.prTitle;
+    document.getElementById('viewRepoTag').textContent = `${review.repository}${
+      review.prNumber ? ` #${review.prNumber}` : ''
+    }`;
+    document.getElementById('viewEngineTag').textContent = `${review.providerUsed}/${review.modelUsed} (${review.durationMs}ms)`;
+
+    document.getElementById('kpiEffort').textContent = `Effort: ${w.effortScore}/5 (~${w.estimatedMinutes}m)`;
+    const kpiRisk = document.getElementById('kpiRisk');
+    kpiRisk.textContent = `Risk: ${w.riskLevel.toUpperCase()}`;
+    kpiRisk.style.color =
+      w.riskLevel === 'critical'
+        ? '#fb7185'
+        : w.riskLevel === 'high'
+        ? '#fbbf24'
+        : '#4ade80';
+
+    document.getElementById('kpiFindings').textContent = `${review.findings.length} Finding${
+      review.findings.length === 1 ? '' : 's'
+    }`;
+
+    document.getElementById('viewExecutiveSummary').innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(
+      w.executiveSummary
+    );
+
+    document.getElementById('rawMarkdownPre').textContent =
+      review.markdownWalkthrough || '';
+
+    // File Walkthrough Table
+    const tbody = document.getElementById('viewFileWalkthroughTable');
+    document.getElementById('viewFileCountHint').textContent = `${w.fileSummaries.length} file(s) changed (+${review.stats.additions}/-${review.stats.deletions})`;
+    tbody.innerHTML = w.fileSummaries
+      .map((f) => {
+        const impactBadge =
+          f.impact === 'high'
+            ? '<span class="sev-badge critical">HIGH</span>'
+            : f.impact === 'medium'
+            ? '<span class="sev-badge warning">MED</span>'
+            : '<span class="sev-badge praise">LOW</span>';
+        return `
+          <tr>
+            <td><code>${escapeHtml(f.path)}</code></td>
+            <td>${escapeHtml(f.component)}</td>
+            <td><span style="color:#4ade80">+${f.additions}</span> / <span style="color:#fb7185">-${f.deletions}</span></td>
+            <td>${impactBadge}</td>
+            <td>${formatInlineMarkdown(f.summary)}</td>
+          </tr>
+        `;
+      })
+      .join('');
+
+    // Poem & Security Advisories
+    document.getElementById('viewPoem').textContent =
+      w.poem || 'Hop onward to merge with a confident mind! 🐇🥕';
+
+    const secBox = document.getElementById('viewSecurityBox');
+    const secList = document.getElementById('viewSecurityList');
+    if (w.securityConcerns && w.securityConcerns.length > 0) {
+      secBox.classList.remove('hidden');
+      secList.innerHTML = w.securityConcerns

+      lines.push(`   ${ANSI.italic}${ANSI.orange}❝ ${pLine}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  lines.push('');
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+async function runCli(): Promise<void> {
+  const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
+  const command = argv[0] && !argv[0].startsWith('--') ? argv[0] : 'help';
+  const flags = parseFlags(argv);
+
+  if (command === 'serve' || command === 'dashboard') {
+    printBanner();
+    const requestedPort = flags.port
+      ? Number(flags.port)
+      : Number(process.env.PORT || 3847);
+    const instance = await createOpenRabbitServer({ port: requestedPort });
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.green}${ANSI.bold}✔ OpenRabbit Server & Interactive Dashboard running at:${ANSI.reset} ${ANSI.cyan}${ANSI.bold}http://localhost:${instance.port}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  ├─ Web Dashboard & PR Playground : http://localhost:${instance.port}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  ├─ GitHub Webhook Endpoint       : http://localhost:${instance.port}/api/webhooks/github${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.dim}  └─ GitLab Webhook Endpoint       : http://localhost:${instance.port}/api/webhooks/gitlab${ANSI.reset}\n`
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'init') {
+    printBanner();
+    const targetYaml = path.join(process.cwd(), '.openrabbit.yaml');
+    if (fs.existsSync(targetYaml) && !flags.force) {
+      console.log(
+        `${ANSI.yellow}ℹ️  .openrabbit.yaml already exists at ${targetYaml} (use --force to overwrite).${ANSI.reset}`
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    fs.writeFileSync(
+      targetYaml,
+      serializeConfigToYaml(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG),
+      'utf8'
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.green}${ANSI.bold}✔ Created .openrabbit.yaml${ANSI.reset} at ${ANSI.cyan}${targetYaml}${ANSI.reset}`
+    );
+    console.log(
+      `  Customize ${ANSI.bold}profile${ANSI.reset} (chill | assertive | security-focused), ${ANSI.bold}path_instructions${ANSI.reset}, and ${ANSI.bold}llm.provider${ANSI.reset}.`
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'review') {
+    const format = String(flags.format || 'terminal');
+    if (format === 'terminal') printBanner();
+
+    const { config } = loadConfig(process.cwd());
+    if (typeof flags.profile === 'string') {
+      config.profile = flags.profile as ReviewProfile;
+    }
+    if (typeof flags.provider === 'string') {
+      config.llm.provider = flags.provider as LLMProviderType;
+    }
+    if (typeof flags.model === 'string') {
+      config.llm.model = flags.model;
+    }
+
+    let rawDiff = '';
+    let prTitle = String(flags.title || 'Local Pull Request Review');
+    let repository = String(flags.repo || 'local/openrabbit');
+
+    if (flags.file && typeof flags.file === 'string') {
+      rawDiff = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(flags.file), 'utf8');
+      prTitle = `Patch Review: ${path.basename(flags.file)}`;
+    } else if (flags.demo) {
+      const tplId =
+        typeof flags.demo === 'string' ? flags.demo : SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].id;
+      const tpl =
+        SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === tplId) ||
+        SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0];
+      rawDiff = tpl.diff;
+      prTitle = tpl.prTitle;
+      repository = tpl.repository;
+    } else {
+      const localGit = getLocalGitDiff({
+        staged: Boolean(flags.staged),
+        baseBranch: typeof flags.base === 'string' ? flags.base : undefined,
+      });
+      if (localGit.diff.trim()) {
+        rawDiff = localGit.diff;
+        prTitle = `Local Review: ${localGit.description}`;
+        repository = localGit.repoName;
+      } else {
+        // Fallback to demo template 1 if repo has no uncommitted changes yet
+        const tpl = SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0];
+        rawDiff = tpl.diff;
+        prTitle = `${tpl.prTitle} (Demo PR — no local uncommitted changes detected)`;
+        repository = tpl.repository;
+      }
+    }
+
+    const result = await runPullRequestReview({
+      rawDiff,
+      prTitle,
+      repository,
+      prNumber: flags.pr ? Number(flags.pr) : undefined,
+      source: 'cli',
+      config,
+    });
+
+    const store = new ReviewStore();
+    await store.addReview(result);
+
+    // Optional: post directly to a live GitHub PR if --post-github owner/repo#123 is passed
+    if (typeof flags['post-github'] === 'string' && process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) {
+      const match = flags['post-github'].match(/^([^/]+)\/([^#]+)#(\d+)$/);
+      if (match) {
+        const [, owner, repo, prNumStr] = match;
+        const prNum = Number(prNumStr);
+        await upsertGitHubWalkthroughComment(
+          owner,
+          repo,
+          prNum,
+          result.markdownWalkthrough,
+          process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+        );
+        if (result.findings.length > 0 && result.commitSha) {
+          await postGitHubInlineReview(
+            owner,
+            repo,
+            prNum,
+            result.commitSha,
+            result.findings,
+            process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+          );
+        }
+        console.log(
+          `${ANSI.green}✔ Posted walkthrough & inline comments to GitHub PR ${flags['post-github']}${ANSI.reset}`
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (format === 'json') {
+      console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
+    } else if (format === 'markdown') {
+      console.log(result.markdownWalkthrough);
+    } else {
+      console.log(renderTerminalReview(result));
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'chat') {
+    printBanner();
+    const query =
+      argv
+        .slice(1)
+        .filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--'))
+        .join(' ') || '@openrabbit explain';
+    const { config } = loadConfig(process.cwd());
+    const localGit = getLocalGitDiff();
+    const diff = localGit.diff.trim() || SAMPLE_DIFF_TEMPLATES[0].diff;
+
+    const res = await handlePRChat({ query, diff }, config);
+    console.log(
+      `${ANSI.bold}${ANSI.cyan}🤖 @openrabbit (${res.commandDetected} · ${res.providerUsed}/${res.modelUsed}):${ANSI.reset}\n`
+    );
+    console.log(res.replyMarkdown);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (command === 'providers') {
+    printBanner();
+    console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Configured LLM Providers (BYOK):${ANSI.reset}\n`);
+    for (const p of getProvidersStatus()) {
+      const status = p.configured
+        ? `${ANSI.green}● Ready${ANSI.reset}`
+        : `${ANSI.gray}○ Missing API Key${ANSI.reset}`;
+      console.log(
+        `  ${status}  ${ANSI.bold}${p.name}${ANSI.reset} (${ANSI.cyan}${p.id}${ANSI.reset}, default: \`${p.defaultModel}\`)`
+      );
+      console.log(`           ${ANSI.dim}${p.description}${ANSI.reset}`);
+    }
+    console.log('');
+    return;
+  }
+
+  // Help output
+  printBanner();
+  console.log(`${ANSI.bold}Usage:${ANSI.reset}
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit review${ANSI.reset} [options]       Run AI PR walkthrough & line-by-line review
+    ${ANSI.dim}--staged${ANSI.reset}                        Review staged git changes
+    ${ANSI.dim}--base <branch>${ANSI.reset}                 Review branch diff against base (e.g. main)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--file <patch>${ANSI.reset}                  Review a specific .diff / .patch file
+    ${ANSI.dim}--demo [id]${ANSI.reset}                     Run against a sample PR diff (auth-jwt-sqli | react-billing-hook | clean-stream-worker)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--profile <mode>${ANSI.reset}                Override profile (chill | assertive | security-focused)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--provider <llm>${ANSI.reset}                Override LLM (auto | openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama | heuristic)
+    ${ANSI.dim}--format <fmt>${ANSI.reset}                  Output format (terminal | markdown | json)
+
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit chat "<query>"${ANSI.reset}          Ask @openrabbit to explain, write unit tests, or fix code
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit serve${ANSI.reset} [--port 3847]    Start Webhook Bot Server & Interactive Web Dashboard
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit init${ANSI.reset}                   Generate a .openrabbit.yaml config file in current repo
+  ${ANSI.cyan}openrabbit providers${ANSI.reset}              List supported BYOK LLM providers and readiness status
+`);
+}
+
+// Run CLI when invoked directly
+const isDirectExecution =
+  process.argv[1] &&
+  (process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.ts') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli/index.js') ||
+    process.argv[1].endsWith('cli\\index.js'));
+
+if (isDirectExecution) {
+  runCli().catch((err) => {
+    console.error(`${ANSI.red}Error:${ANSI.reset}`, err);
+    process.exit(1);
+  });
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import YAML from 'yaml';
+import type { OpenRabbitConfig, PathInstruction } from '../types/index.js';
+
+export const DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG: OpenRabbitConfig = {
+  language: 'en-US',
+  profile: 'chill',
+  tone_instructions:
+    'Be constructive, concise, and high-signal. Prioritize real bugs, security vulnerabilities, race conditions, and performance bottlenecks over stylistic nitpicks.',
+  early_access: true,
+  reviews: {
+    high_level_summary: true,
+    poem: true,
+    review_status: true,
+    collapse_walkthrough: false,
+    sequence_diagrams: true,
+    auto_review: {
+      enabled: true,
+      drafts: false,
+      base_branches: ['main', 'master', 'develop'],
+    },
+    path_filters: [
+      '!dist/**',
+      '!node_modules/**',
+      '!*.lock',
+      '!package-lock.json',
+      '!pnpm-lock.yaml',
+      '!**/*.min.js',
+      '!**/*.snap',
+    ],
+    path_instructions: [
+      {
+        path: 'src/api/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Verify authentication checks, input validation, rate limiting, and SQL/command injection safety on all endpoints.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: '**/*.tsx',
+        instructions:
+          'Check for React hook dependency array bugs, stale closures, memory leaks in useEffect, and accessibility attributes.',
+      },
+      {
+        path: 'tests/**',
+        instructions:
+          'Ensure tests cover edge cases, error paths, and avoid brittle timing assumptions.',
+      },
+    ],
+  },
+  chat: {
+    auto_reply: true,
+  },
+  llm: {
+    provider: 'auto',
+    temperature: 0.2,
+  },
+};
+
+const CONFIG_FILENAMES = [
+  '.openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.openrabbit.yml',
+  'openrabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yaml',
+  '.coderabbit.yml',
+];
+
+export function loadConfig(workspaceDir: string = process.cwd()): {
+  config: OpenRabbitConfig;
+  configPath: string | null;
+} {
+  for (const filename of CONFIG_FILENAMES) {
+    const candidate = path.join(workspaceDir, filename);
+    if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) {
+      try {
+        const raw = fs.readFileSync(candidate, 'utf8');
+        const parsed = YAML.parse(raw) || {};
+        return {
+          config: mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed),
+          configPath: candidate,
+        };
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.warn(`Warning: Failed to parse ${candidate}, using defaults.`, err);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    config: structuredClone(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG),
+    configPath: null,
+  };
+}
+
+export function parseYamlConfig(yamlContent: string): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const parsed = YAML.parse(yamlContent) || {};
+  return mergeConfig(DEFAULT_OPENRABBIT_CONFIG, parsed);
+}
+
+export function serializeConfigToYaml(config: OpenRabbitConfig): string {
+  const header = `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://openrabbit.dev/schema/v1.json
+# ============================================================================
+# OpenRabbit Configuration (.openrabbit.yaml)
+# Open-Source AI Pull Request Reviewer & Interactive PR Companion
+# ============================================================================
+
+`;
+  return header + YAML.stringify(config, { indent: 2 });
+}
+
+export function mergeConfig(
+  base: OpenRabbitConfig,
+  override: Record<string, any>
+): OpenRabbitConfig {
+  const merged = structuredClone(base);
+
+  if (typeof override.language === 'string') merged.language = override.language;
+  if (
+    override.profile === 'chill' ||
+    override.profile === 'assertive' ||
+    override.profile === 'security-focused'
+  ) {
+    merged.profile = override.profile;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.tone_instructions === 'string') {
+    merged.tone_instructions = override.tone_instructions;
+  }
+  if (typeof override.early_access === 'boolean') {
+    merged.early_access = override.early_access;
+  }
+
+  if (override.reviews && typeof override.reviews === 'object') {
+    const r = override.reviews;
+    if (typeof r.high_level_summary === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.high_level_summary = r.high_level_summary;
+    if (typeof r.poem === 'boolean') merged.reviews.poem = r.poem;
+    if (typeof r.review_status === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.review_status = r.review_status;
+    if (typeof r.collapse_walkthrough === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.collapse_walkthrough = r.collapse_walkthrough;
+    if (typeof r.sequence_diagrams === 'boolean')
+      merged.reviews.sequence_diagrams = r.sequence_diagrams;
+
+    if (r.auto_review && typeof r.auto_review === 'object') {
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.enabled === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.enabled = r.auto_review.enabled;
+      if (typeof r.auto_review.drafts === 'boolean')
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.drafts = r.auto_review.drafts;
+      if (Array.isArray(r.auto_review.base_branches))
+        merged.reviews.auto_review.base_branches = r.auto_review.base_branches;
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_filters)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_filters = r.path_filters;
+    }
+    if (Array.isArray(r.path_instructions)) {
+      merged.reviews.path_instructions = r.path_instructions.filter(
+        (item: any) => item && typeof item.path === 'string' && typeof item.instructions === 'string'
+      );
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.chat && typeof override.chat === 'object') {
+    if (typeof override.chat.auto_reply === 'boolean') {
+      merged.chat.auto_reply = override.chat.auto_reply;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (override.llm && typeof override.llm === 'object') {
+    if (override.llm.provider) merged.llm.provider = override.llm.provider;
+    if (override.llm.model !== undefined) merged.llm.model = override.llm.model;
+    if (typeof override.llm.temperature === 'number') {
+      merged.llm.temperature = override.llm.temperature;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return merged;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts a glob pattern like `src/api/**` or `*.lock` into a RegExp.
+ */
+export function globToRegex(glob: string): RegExp {
+  const normalized = glob.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  let regexStr = '^';
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < normalized.length) {
+    const c = normalized[i];
+    if (c === '*') {
+      if (normalized[i + 1] === '*') {
+        if (normalized[i + 2] === '/') {
+          regexStr += '(?:.+/)?';
+          i += 3;
+          continue;
+        } else {
+          regexStr += '.*';
+          i += 2;
+          continue;
+        }
+      } else {
+        regexStr += '[^/]*';
+      }
+    } else if (c === '?') {
+      regexStr += '[^/]';
+    } else if ('.+^$()|[]\\{}'.includes(c)) {
+      regexStr += '\\' + c;
+    } else {
+      regexStr += c;
+    }
+    i++;
+  }
+  regexStr += '$';
+  return new RegExp(regexStr, 'i');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Checks whether a file path should be included according to `reviews.path_filters`.
+ * Supports positive globs (`src/**`) and negative exclusion globs (`!dist/**`).
+ */
+export function shouldReviewFile(filePath: string, pathFilters: string[]): boolean {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  if (!pathFilters || pathFilters.length === 0) return true;
+
+  const positiveFilters = pathFilters.filter((f) => !f.startsWith('!'));
+  const negativeFilters = pathFilters
+    .filter((f) => f.startsWith('!'))
+    .map((f) => f.slice(1));
+
+  // Check exclusions first
+  for (const neg of negativeFilters) {
+    if (globToRegex(neg).test(normalized) || globToRegex(`**/${neg}`).test(normalized)) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // If positive filters exist, file must match at least one
+  if (positiveFilters.length > 0) {
+    return positiveFilters.some((pos) => globToRegex(pos).test(normalized));
+  }
+
+  return true;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns all matching path_instructions for a given file path.
+ */
+export function getMatchingPathInstructions(
+  filePath: string,
+  instructions: PathInstruction[]
+): PathInstruction[] {
+  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\.\//, '');
+  return (instructions || []).filter((inst) =>
+    globToRegex(inst.path).test(normalized)
+  );
+}
